segments.name: Real estate services
segments.description: Operates internet real estate services in China, with revenue primarily earned from real estate developers.
segments.evidence: Foreign ownership in the business involving value-added telecommunications service (except for e-commerce, domestic conferencing, store-and-forward, and call center services), including internet real estate services, is subject to significant restrictions under current PRC laws, rules and regulations.

revenueModel.text: Real estate developers are the primary source of revenue, paying the company for its services.
revenueModel.evidence: Accounts receivable are typically unsecured and are primarily derived from revenue earned from real estate developers.
